description: This source file defines the implementation of the DobbySpecGenerator class, which generates container specifications for application runtime environments. It includes methods to generate configuration JSON for containers, set up environment variables, mounts, and plugins, and manage dependencies and capabilities.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating container specifications based on application configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: Json::Value getWorkingDir(const ApplicationConfiguration & config,const WPEFramework::Exchange::RuntimeConfig & runtimeConfig) const
methods.description: Returns the working directory for the application based on the configuration, defaulting to the package mount point.

methods.name: bool generate(const ApplicationConfiguration & config,const WPEFramework::Exchange::RuntimeConfig & runtimeConfig,string & resultSpec)
methods.description: Generates the container spec JSON string based on the provided configuration and runtime parameters. It includes reading existing specs, setting up resource limits, args, environment, mounts, plugins, etc.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variable array for the container from application and runtime configs, including special environment settings.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates the list of bind mounts and other filesystem mounts required for the container, based on application paths and configuration.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Helper to create a bind mount JSON object with specified source, destination, and flags.

methods.name: bool shouldEnableGpu(const ApplicationConfiguration & config) const
methods.description: Determines whether GPU (Westeros) support should be enabled based on application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates the system memory limit for the container based on configuration and runtime info.

methods.name: ssize_t getGPUMemoryLimit(const ApplicationConfiguration & config,const WPEFramework::Exchange::RuntimeConfig & runtimeConfig) const
methods.description: Calculates GPU memory limit for the container based on configuration and runtime info.

methods.name: bool getVpuEnabled(const ApplicationConfiguration & config,const WPEFramework::Exchange::RuntimeConfig & runtimeConfig) const
methods.description: Checks whether VPU support is enabled for the application, considering blacklist and app type.

methods.name: std::string getCpuCores()
methods.description: Returns a string listing the CPU cores enabled for the application, respecting the application's CPU set mask.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates the RDK plugin configuration part of the spec, including ion memory, networking, minidump, and other plugins.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the minidump plugin, with paths for crash data.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the application service SDK plugin, including ports.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates network plugin configuration, including NAT or private network and IPv6.

methods.name: void populateClassicPlugins(const ApplicationConfiguration & config,const WPEFramework::Exchange::RuntimeConfig & runtimeConfig,Json::Value & spec)
methods.description: Populates standard plugins such as logging, OpenCDM, multicast, hole puncher, etc.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the EthanLog plugin with log levels.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Stub for multicast socket plugin configuration (not implemented).

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates ion memory plugin configuration using internal data.

methods.name: Json::Value createThunderPlugin(const ApplicationConfiguration & config) const
methods.description: Creates Thunder plugin configuration with local services URL.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates OpenCDM plugin configuration.

methods.name: void initialiseIonHeapsJson()
methods.description: Initializes ion memory heap quota data for plugin configuration.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates a mount configuration for private data directory.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Sets up FKPS file mounts, modifies file permissions, and adds bind mounts for FKPS files.

methods.name: Json::Value createTmpfsMount(const std::string & mntDestination,unsigned long mntOptions) const
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount configuration with specified options.

methods.name: Json::Value createResourceManagerMount(const ApplicationConfiguration & config) const
methods.description: Creates a bind mount for resource manager socket folder, adjusting permissions.

methods.name: std::string encodeURL(std::string url) const
methods.description: Encodes a URL string for use in HTTP requests via libcurl.

methods.name: addHolePunchPortToSpec
methods.description: Adds a port forwarding rule to the spec JSON for hole punching, supporting both RDK and classic formats.
